meta.description: Identify direct miRNA-target interactions from AGO HITS-CLIP, AGO-CLEAR-CLIP (chimeric reads), HEAP (Halo-Ago2 mouse), chimeric eCLIP / miR-eCLIP (deep miRNA-target profiling), or CLASH using chimeric-read processing pipelines, seed-pairing analysis, and 3' auxiliary pairing rules. Use when distinguishing direct miRNA targets from indirect, integrating CLIP-derived target maps with TargetScan / miRDB / DIANA predictions, applying canonical 7mer-8mer seed matching with 3' UTR context, or recovering miRNA-mRNA chimeras at scale.

scientific_integrity.detail: No unverified biological result, study size, p-value, DOI, or PMID was generated by the bounded audit fixtures; direct and inferred evidence remain labeled separately.

practice_boundaries.detail: The skill is a research analysis workflow and makes no patient-specific diagnostic or treatment recommendation.

methodological_ground.detail: Direct chimera evidence, AGO-binding evidence, and computational prediction are distinguished; species, assay, expression, and coordinate contexts are retained with explicit limitations.

code_usability.detail: All locally accessible shipped scripts and focused routes executed in the prepared environment; unavailable biological and remote surfaces are classified with their missing inputs or service failure.

functional_suitability.note: Direct chimera, indirect assignment, coordinate projection, consensus filtering, and protocol-declared UMI routes align with their stated use; the finite-expression bypass is repaired and regression-tested.

reliability.note: Input checks, fail-closed validation, stable replicate consensus, atomic output publication, and useful diagnostics are present; external biological workflows still depend on matched inputs.

performance_context.note: Progressive references and bounded local fixtures keep routine reasoning separate from costly or unavailable biological execution.

agent_usability.note: Method selection, inputs, output schemas, provenance, and stop conditions are explicit; protocol-specific preprocessing still requires local protocol metadata.

human_usability.note: Clear workflow tables and failure guidance support review; several advanced routes require domain-specific reference preparation.

security.note: No credential handling or raw user-string evaluation is present; file validation and controlled atomic outputs are exercised.

maintainability.note: Documentation is separated into four references, scripts have focused responsibilities, and the shipped suite covers key contracts.

agent_specific.note: Triggering, progressive disclosure, reproducibility, and escape hatches are clear; correct biological interpretation still depends on human protocol and assay context.

inputs.label: Fresh pinned Hyb cross-workflow repeatability

assertions.text: Two fresh workflows produce identical structured sites, targets, support, exclusions, and manifests
assertions.note: All structured artifact hashes match across independent workflow roots.

assertions.text: Each underlying Hyb run has the advertised row schema and 111 assignments
assertions.note: Four raw replicate files each contain 111 rows with 16 fields.

assertions.text: Each retained read has support from every replicate
assertions.note: All 111 retained support rows show 2/2 and supporting indices 1,2.

assertions.text: Workflow manifests reconcile assignment and target counts
assertions.note: Both manifests report 111 accepted, 0 excluded, 2 replicates, and 111 target rows.

assertions.text: Timestamped stdout differences are bounded and disclosed
assertions.note: Only the first timestamp line differs; remaining stdout and all non-stdout files match.

inputs.note: Two independently staged two-replicate Hyb workflows retained 111 stable assignments each; structured products matched.

inputs.label: Wrapper failure and publication boundaries

assertions.text: Paths with spaces and literal wildcard characters are handled literally
assertions.note: The shipped wrapper regression completed its spaced and wildcard-path fixture.

assertions.text: An existing output is protected without explicit replacement
assertions.note: The repeat invocation returns status 73 and preserves the existing result.

assertions.text: A failing Hyb exit status reaches the caller
assertions.note: The controlled status 42 is propagated.

assertions.text: A failed replacement preserves prior output
assertions.note: The sentinel is unchanged after the forced replacement failure.

assertions.text: A failed staged run cleans its temporary stage
assertions.note: The harness found no residual stage directory.

inputs.note: Fresh shipped regressions exercised literal paths, overwrite protection, failure propagation, replacement preservation, and cleanup.

inputs.label: Consensus schema, orientation, and finite expression parsing

assertions.text: Both segment orientations normalize to the same miRNA-target contract
assertions.note: Fresh orientation fixtures preserve correct IDs and coordinate fields.

assertions.text: Finite values above threshold are accepted and below-threshold values are excluded with a reason
assertions.note: The 150-valued row is accepted; the 50-valued row receives below_expression_threshold at threshold 100.

assertions.text: All accepted NaN and infinity spellings fail before output publication
assertions.note: Thirteen float() spellings, including signed/case variants of NaN, Inf, and Infinity, were rejected as expression values and thresholds with no result files.

assertions.text: Malformed, blank, and missing expression values fail closed
assertions.note: Nonnumeric, blank, and short-row values failed with source-line diagnostics and no result files.

assertions.text: Non-finite thresholds fail before output publication
assertions.note: NaN, +Inf, -Inf, Infinity, and -Infinity thresholds were rejected; no result files appeared.

inputs.note: Parser normalization and the AGO-009 edge contract passed fresh finite, non-finite, malformed, missing, and threshold checks.

inputs.label: TargetScan spliced-coordinate and strand projection

assertions.text: Plus- and minus-strand sites project to multi-block BED12
assertions.note: Both UTR-relative fixtures produce two blocks with their original strands.

assertions.text: Split, strand-aware overlap excludes the opposite-strand peak
assertions.note: Expected plus and minus overlaps remain; the wrong-strand peak is absent.

assertions.text: TargetScan release mismatch is rejected
assertions.note: The version mismatch returns nonzero with a release-metadata diagnostic.

assertions.text: Out-of-range UTR sites fail closed
assertions.note: The converter rejects the site rather than truncating it.

assertions.text: Manifest retains assembly and annotation provenance
assertions.note: Output records GRCh38, GENCODEv49, and TargetScan 8.0.

inputs.note: Fresh plus/minus exon-spanning fixtures preserved BED12 blocks and rejected release and range errors.

inputs.label: Targeted miR-eCLIP UMI declaration and fail-closed behavior

assertions.text: A declared 9-nt UMI extracts exactly nine R2-prefix bases
assertions.note: The emitted header contains ACGTACGTA and the manifest records length 9.

assertions.text: A declared 10-nt UMI extracts exactly ten R2-prefix bases
assertions.note: The emitted header contains ACGTACGTAC and the manifest records length 10.

assertions.text: Successful output binds length to library and protocol provenance
assertions.note: Both manifests include library ID, protocol source, and input/output hashes.

assertions.text: Missing, zero, non-integer, or blank declarations fail without outputs
assertions.note: All five declaration errors return nonzero and leave FASTQ/manifest absent.

assertions.text: R2 shorter than the declared length fails without outputs
assertions.note: A 13-nt declaration against 12-nt R2 returns nonzero and publishes nothing.

inputs.note: All required bounded checks passed with inspected output.

inputs.label: Unavailable biological and remote surfaces

assertions.text: Direct chimera evidence remains distinct from computational predictions
assertions.note: Method guidance labels ordinary AGO-CLIP assignments as inferred and chimera pairs as direct.

assertions.text: Human and mouse HEAP contexts are not conflated
assertions.note: HEAP is kept within its Halo-Ago2 mouse model context.

assertions.text: Unrun full workflows require their real biological inputs
assertions.note: Full Yeo and HEAP surfaces are recorded as unavailable without matched biological materials and references.

assertions.text: Unavailable DIANA service is reported rather than simulated as a result
assertions.note: The HTTP 500 surface remains an explicit service availability limitation.

assertions.text: Synthetic evidence is not represented as biological validation
assertions.note: No wet-lab or clinical conclusion is claimed by the bounded synthetic fixtures.

inputs.note: All required bounded checks passed with inspected output.

inputs.label: Secondary UMI, trimming, and soft-clip diagnostic boundaries

assertions.text: The total-Yeo route extracts its documented ten-base read-1 UMI
assertions.note: The fixture header contains the expected 10-nt suffix.

assertions.text: Paired adapter trimming retains the expected insert lengths
assertions.note: Both trimmed reads are 20 nt after adapter removal.

assertions.text: The soft-clip diagnostic counts clipped records
assertions.note: One 5M5S record is counted and the 10M control is not.

assertions.text: A soft-clip count is not represented as a chimera call
assertions.note: Documentation describes it as a candidate-pool diagnostic only.

assertions.text: Synthetic checks remain distinguished from unavailable full biological workflows
assertions.note: Full Yeo and wet-lab paths remain deferred with the required inputs recorded.

inputs.note: Bounded synthetic fixtures passed and the soft-clip command remained labeled diagnostic-only.

key_strengths: Fresh pinned Hyb workflows produced identical structured consensus outputs with per-read support for every retained assignment.
Expression parsing rejects non-finite and malformed inputs before publishing outputs while reason-coding finite below-threshold exclusions.
The Skill separates direct chimera evidence from inferred assignments and preserves coordinate, protocol, and provenance contracts.
